title: Find your kind of day.
kicker: OPEN DOOR / CULTURAL DISCOVERY WITH QLOO
label: User-supplied mascot artwork · AI-generated Allison narration
voice: You have a free afternoon in a new place. You want to explore, but what fits your interests, your energy, and your time? Open Door helps you find your kind of day.
metadata: Current Open Door app recording with successful live Qloo API results, an independent live branch comparison, a real Word download, a browser-local save, and a public guest link. Voice-input interface preview uses a scripted transcript, not live speech recognition. Partnership placements are fictional mockups. No signed-in account is shown. AI-generated Allison narration.

title: Describe your day. Open a possibility.
label: Real app UI · Voice interaction preview: scripted transcript, not live transcription
voice: Start with what you already love. Then describe what matters today. Type, or use voice input in a supported browser. Here's the kind of brief you might give: I'm visiting for a wedding. I'd love a relaxed afternoon, with easy walking, something creative, and time for a coffee. Review your words, make any changes, and explore.

title: Qloo grounds the cultural connections.
label: Live Qloo retrieval · Hidden-gem activities are authored ideas, not verified venues
voice: Here's where Qloo makes the difference. Its Search and Insights APIs connect the cultural interests I chose with new directions to explore. Open Door turns those connections into understandable recommendations, not just another list. I can open a door without leaving the page, try a hidden-gem activity, and inspect the evidence behind the cultural connection. Use the shared live connection, or connect your own Qloo credentials.

title: Make a plan. Take it with you.
label: Guest save and Word download · Maps searches do not verify local businesses
voice: Now discovery becomes something I can use. Search Maps, shape a flexible day, or download a plan to take along. Save a door in this browser, or sign in for account-backed saves and optional preference memory. Personal planning notes don't need to become permanent account memory.

title: Explore two paths. Keep your starting point.
label: Live Qloo exploration · Checkpoints and branch histories stay in this browser
voice: Not sure which direction to take? Discovery Lab makes room to experiment. Keep a checkpoint, explore two different paths, and compare what each one returns. Each branch continues independently, so trying something unexpected doesn't mean losing your starting point. It's a clearer way to explore your options before choosing.

title: One shared occasion. Their own discoveries.
label: Actual organizer tools · Guest links include public place and occasion, not private preferences
voice: And sometimes, you're helping other people explore. A wedding organizer can set the place and occasion, then share a starting link with guests. The same tools support travelers and future neighbors, too. Everyone starts with a shared context, but each person chooses their own interests and shapes their own experience.

title: Free discovery. A company-funded opportunity.
label: Proposed business model · Fictional sponsored mockups, not Qloo endorsements
voice: There's a potential business model here, too: keep individual exploration free, while companies could fund branded guest experiences and clearly labeled partner placements. These interactive mockups show how a featured hotel or dining partner could appear. They're illustrative, not existing partnerships or Qloo endorsements. Interested companies can already send an inquiry.
